newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kookmin Bank sets 1-for-10 rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Kookmin Bank sets 1-for-10 rights offer.

text.p: South Korea's Kookmin Bank said on Thursday it would offer a 1-for-10 rights issue in June to raise funds to support small and mid-sized firms.
The issue will increase paid-in capital to 523.2 billion won from about 464.37 billion at present.

A Kookmin statement said the company plans to issue 11.76 million new common shares, of which 20 percent would be offered to its employees. The rest will be allocated to shareholders registered as of May 9 for rights.
The issue price will be set at a 25 percent discount to the base price, which will be decided later.
Shareholders' subscription is scheduled for June 3 and 4, with payment due by June 23.
In late Thursday trading, Kookmin Bank shares were flat at 11,800.
